summary: Shows an add_host helper that uses all three constructed methods, notes fetch_hostvars controls use of existing host vars, and explains group name sanitization and overriding _sanitize_group_name alongside TRANSFORM_INVALID_GROUP_CHARS.
questions: How are invalid characters in generated group names handled?
Can I stop keyed_groups from using host vars from earlier inventory sources?
How do I customize group name sanitization in my inventory plugin?

answer_card.title: Constructed example and group name sanitizing
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
self._set_composite_vars(self.get_option('compose'), host_vars, hostname, strict=True)
self._add_host_to_composed_groups(self.get_option('groups'), host_vars, hostname, strict=strict)
self._add_host_to_keyed_groups(self.get_option('keyed_groups'), host_vars, hostname, strict=strict)
```
- Existing host vars are used; pass `fetch_hostvars` to turn that off.
- Group names are made valid Python identifiers (invalid chars → `_`). Override with `self._sanitize_group_name`; if less strict, combine with `TRANSFORM_INVALID_GROUP_CHARS`.
